name: eduai-platform
description: EduAI: Campus educativo virtual integrado con asistente de IA

scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n backend,ai,frontend -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev:local --workspace ai-service" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.ai:setup: cd ai-service && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && npm run ai:test && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
